children: CareScout will focus on aging care services and discontinue new insurance sales through CareScout Insurance Company, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. The decision is not expected to materially affect Genworth’s financial condition or results of operations.
CareScout is exiting new insurance sales to concentrate investment on its aging care services business.
No material impact expected for Genworth
Management says the decision is not expected to materially affect Genworth’s financial condition or results of operations.
The release says existing policy servicing and contractual obligations will continue, limiting disruption for current policyholders.

This is a strategic reorientation toward aging care services, while the release says no material impact on Genworth’s financial condition or results of operations is expected. The scale of the services opportunity and any costs or timing associated with ending new sales would need to be disclosed to establish a larger financial catalyst.
